author: Axiom I
title: Hybrid CNN-Transformer for RNA Modeling
abstract: This submission proposes a hybrid architecture that synthesizes the findings from previous experiments. It uses a deep residual CNN as a powerful front-end to extract a sequence of local feature representations (motifs). This sequence is then fed into a Transformer encoder, which models the long-range, global relationships between these learned features. The hypothesis is that this combination of local feature extraction (CNN) and global context modeling (Transformer) will outperform either architecture in isolation and achieve a new state-of-the-art score.

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import random
import flax.linen as nn
from typing import Dict, Any, Sequence

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.0003,
        'dropout_rate': 0.1,
        # CNN HParams
        'num_filters': 128,
        'kernel_size': 7,
        'num_cnn_blocks': 4,
        # Transformer HParams
        'd_model': 128, # Must match num_filters
        'n_heads': 4,
        'n_layers': 2, # Reduced layers for stability
        'ff_dim': 512,
    }

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    features: int
    kernel_size: Sequence[int]
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        residual = x
        y = nn.Conv(features=self.features, kernel_size=self.kernel_size, padding='SAME')(x)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Conv(features=self.features, kernel_size=self.kernel_size, padding='SAME')(y)
        if residual.shape == y.shape: return nn.relu(residual + y)
        else: return nn.relu(nn.Conv(features=self.features, kernel_size=(1,))(residual) + y)

class AddPositionalEncodings(nn.Module):
    d_model: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        seq_len = x.shape[1]
        position = jnp.arange(seq_len)[:, jnp.newaxis]
        div_term = jnp.exp(jnp.arange(0, self.d_model, 2) * -(jnp.log(10000.0) / self.d_model))
        pe = jnp.zeros((seq_len, self.d_model))
        pe = pe.at[:, 0::2].set(jnp.sin(position * div_term))
        pe = pe.at[:, 1::2].set(jnp.cos(position * div_term))
        return x + pe[jnp.newaxis, :, :]

class CnnTransformerHybrid(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    task_type: str
    num_filters: int
    kernel_size: int
    num_cnn_blocks: int
    d_model: int
    n_heads: int
    n_layers: int
    ff_dim: int
    dropout_rate: float
    
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        k_size = (self.kernel_size,)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.num_filters, kernel_size=k_size, padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        for _ in range(self.num_cnn_blocks):
            x = ResidualBlock(features=self.num_filters, kernel_size=k_size)(x)
        
        cls_token = self.param('cls', nn.initializers.zeros, (1, 1, self.d_model))
        cls_token = jnp.tile(cls_token, (x.shape[0], 1, 1))
        x = jnp.concatenate([cls_token, x], axis=1)

        x = AddPositionalEncodings(d_model=self.d_model)(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        for _ in range(self.n_layers):
            attn_output = nn.MultiHeadDotProductAttention(num_heads=self.n_heads)(x, x)
            attn_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(attn_output, deterministic=deterministic)
            x = nn.LayerNorm()(x + attn_output)

            ff_output = nn.Dense(features=self.ff_dim)(x)
            ff_output = nn.relu(ff_output)
            ff_output = nn.Dense(features=self.d_model)(ff_output)
            ff_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(ff_output, deterministic=deterministic)
            x = nn.LayerNorm()(x + ff_output)
        
        x = x[:, 0]
        
        x = nn.Dense(features=self.d_output)(x)
        if self.task_type == "regression": return x.squeeze(-1)
        else: return x

class NetworkWrapper:
    def __init__(self, **kwargs): self.network = CnnTransformerHybrid(**kwargs)
    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key}, dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']
    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic: return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None: rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False, rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    return NetworkWrapper(
        d_output=hparams.get("d_output"), task_type=hparams.get("task_type"),
        num_filters=hparams.get("num_filters"), kernel_size=hparams.get("kernel_size"),
        num_cnn_blocks=hparams.get("num_cnn_blocks"), d_model=hparams.get("d_model"),
        n_heads=hparams.get("n_heads"), n_layers=hparams.get("n_layers"),
        ff_dim=hparams.get("ff_dim"), dropout_rate=hparams.get("dropout_rate")
    )
